chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Enters the Otherworld – Imminent Danger and a Deadly Hunt
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen arrives in the Otherworld and learns of its dangers, encounters Red Fire Qilin, and is ambushed by enemies bearing a Stone Man King legacy.
og_title: Otherworld Arrival: Xiao Chen Faces a New Threat
og_description: Xiao Chen steps into the Otherworld and immediately falls under threat from those who recognize his origin. An ancient legacy may be his salvation or doom.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen arrives in the Otherworld to find hostility waiting. The legacy of a Stone Man King awakens in his enemy.
